## What it is

The mounting ring. Inside Ø101.2, outside Ø114.4, band 2.4 mm thick and 6.6 mm wide. Four lobes, 4 mm tall, each with a 4.2 × 8.2 mm slot. Four Ø3.4 holes on the 76.2 mm square. The middle is open for the cable.

## Design notes

- Each lobe reaches in from the band and the slot takes a 4.0 × 8.0 mm tower tab, 4 mm long.
- The holes sit on the band just outside the lobes. 1.6 mm of wall around each hole, except about 1.4 mm where a lobe meets the band.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.2
```

## Don't

- Don't fill the middle of the ring. The cable comes up there.
- Don't move the four M3 holes. Those are the deck.

## Changelog

- 2026-11-25: thinned to the bolt circle. Tabs flank the towers. The middle is open for the cable.
